verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for a public register data service, since such portals can offer APIs or bulk/programmatic access. The evidence only shows an interactive web search UI (normal/extended search, announcements) and a 'non-binding' structured-information retrieval service, with no API, CLI, or documented automated access. The llms.txt probe returned 404, so there is no evidence the product can run headlessly or in CI.
